method: Opened all 3 contact sheets, the negscan sheet and pair_000 to pair_026 (first third of the 80 sorted strip/pair images) one at a time; pulled exact frames 0, 146, 147, 384, 385, 414 and 478-565 with ffmpeg select into a private scratch folder to check the seam-1 framing and the dark block on the gym card. || Sorted the 80 strip and pair images by name; part 2 is the middle third plus one image either side so no image falls between judges: pair_026 to pair_039 and strip_000 to strip_014 (29 images). Opened every one with the Read tool. Checked captions against the word timings in cut_audit/plan.json. Pulled 22 exact frames with the ffmpeg select filter into scratch folder jad8e2 (243, 384, 478, 520, 580, 1206, 1240, 1282, 1284, 1500, 1530, 1548, 1600, 1630 to 1678) to confirm the first real-photo chip, seam 1 framing, the gym B-roll black block, the AI picture, the lower third and the CTA tail at full size. || Opened all 27 images of the last third of the sorted strip/pair list (strip_013 to strip_039) with the Read tool; read plan.json, cut_plan.json and cutdown_ranges.json; pulled exact frames with ffmpeg select (477, 520, 560, 1440, 1485 to 1492, 1513, 1594, 1620 to 1678) into a scratch folder to check the gym-card black block, seam 3 headroom, the lower-third wipe and the CTA ending.

entries.note: Hook 0-4 s: lower third 'AI Showed Me Two Pictures' types on, readable, no caption under it. Talking head framed with hair inside the top edge on every tile, both shoulders in. Captions legible and match the inferred speech ('one was a goal.', 'Here's how I avoided', 'A few years ago, I was', 'a busy, stressed out', 'dad with no', 'motivation.', 'I knew exactly what I', 'was supposed to do and', 'I did none of it.', 'Nothing worked'). No black or frozen tiles, no placeholder.
AI heavy poolside picture 3.97-5.6 s carries ONE 'AI-GENERATED' chip on the wall right of the head, clear of face and body; captions suppressed over a labelled picture of Dan.
Two real photos 8.1-12.8 s each carry ONE 'Real picture of me - not AI-generated' chip (top left beside the head, then top centre above the head), neither on face or abs; captions suppressed.

Dark gym card 15.9-19.5 s shows a black block on the right fifth of the picture in the first ~2 s. Exact frames 478-565 pulled: it is a dark foreground object in the stock clip that slides out as the camera tracks (parallax, slanted edge, changes every frame), not a crop fault or a black frame.
Phone lock-screen card 22.7-26.4 s: 'AI-GENERATED' chip sits under the card (declared clearance offset), captions suppressed.

Phone card, talking head, training / meal prep / calorie cards, talking head, AI abs poolside picture, flash return, talking head. Captions legible and match speech ('I looked at it dozens', 'of times a day, every', 'day for over a year.', 'And that's what gave', 'me the fire to train', 'consistently, to meal', 'prep every week and to', 'track my calories.', 'This picture helped me', 'so much that I built', 'an app that does', 'exactly this.', 'Once you generate it,', 'our AI builds you a', 'personalized workout', 'and nutrition plan to', 'make it real.', 'You get the picture'). Hair inside the top edge everywhere, no wide level, no junk text.

Seam 2 (40.2 s) lands on a change of picture: talking head 'exactly this.' to the full-frame AI abs picture with ONE 'AI-GENERATED' chip on the wall left of the head, clear of face and abs; captions suppressed; white flash on the return at 43.0 s.
Seam 3 (48.05 s): 'make it real.' then 'You get the picture', a sentence boundary; the exact cut frames belong to another judge's strips (pair_033).

Lower third 'You get the plan that makes it real.' types on with no caption under it; 'So pick your future.' caption; CTA pill 'Get A FREE AI Image Of Yourself With Abs' on the chest, not on the face, no caption under it; ends on the call to action with a closed-mouth hold. Hair inside the frame on all tiles.
Lower third start; same continuous take, no cut, no jump. Hair inside top edge.
Continuous take, card/lower third animating in below frame crop; no jump.
punch FAR ramp start: no join, picture continuous; lower third fully typed 'AI Showed Me Two Pictures'.
Cut from talking head to the AI heavy picture; lower third in its last fade frame on the -1 side (ghost text, finishing its fade, not cut mid-animation); AI-GENERATED chip clear of the face.
